note: USACE Nashville District campground on Lake Barkley near Kuttawa, at the end of the road. About half the sites (04-11, 13-15, 17) line the shore a couple of metres above the summer lake; the rest sit in the woods behind. Playground, boat ramp, swimming area and a picnic shelter; the 2.5-mile Chestnut Oaks Trail starts here. --Claude
